tier2_explanatory.long_meaning: From the Old English ead, 'wealth', + weard, 'guardian'. Its root is Old English ead + weard. Saint Edward the Confessor, king of England. Edward is a English name meaning “Wealthy guardian; rich guard”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
